subject: [hw] DEC04 -> lead: exact rev 3 text needed; larb policy for the model; 0x16001000 test conflict noted to V40
body:
DEC04 status and two decisions I need from you.

1) header rev 3. include/redwood_vcodec.h is still rev 2 (RWVC_WIN_COUNT == 12), so my patch cannot compile in the tree. Please confirm or correct this exact text, which is what DEC07 and opus-vdec proposed and what my /tmp staging currently inserts after RWVC_WIN_VDEC_SOC_GCON:

    RWVC_WIN_VDEC_SOC_GCON, RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL, RWVC_WIN_COUNT };
  /* RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL: 0x16000000+0x30000, the single mapping the vendor decoder takes; offsets are checked by
   * 4 KiB page against the domain that powers them (0x00000-0x1ffff VDE, 0x20000-0x2ffff VDE2). */

Questions: (a) is RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL appended as index 12 and RWVC_WIN_COUNT becomes 13? (b) any larb-specific window instead? DEC07 proposes no separate enum, larb5 0x1600d000 and larb4 0x1602e000 inside VDEC_ALL, read-only with an allow-list hook in the kernel. (c) any other hunk in the header (e.g. a comment only)? My V40 patch spells RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL, not a literal 12, and my acceptance staging adds only the enum if the tree header lacks it.

2) larb pages in V40s model. vcu_windows[] only maps addresses to RWVC windows; it has no writability policy. With VDEC_ALL covering 0x0d000 and 0x2e000 the model routes the vendor larb accesses to window 12 and mmio_bad stays 0; the read-only/allow-list rule then lives in the kernel (DEC07) and in T02s fake, not in V40. Unless you decide otherwise, my patch does exactly that and my test asserts both larb pages are reachable through VDEC_ALL (and that mmio_bad stays 0 on the DEC02 page list). If you want a V40-side write refusal for those two pages, say so and give the allowed offsets; I will add it behind the same switch (default off) so no existing behaviour changes.

3) DEC02 PAGES.md does not exist yet (facts/vdec_trace/ absent). My host oracle replays the page list of facts/VDEC_PROTOCOL.md section 4 as the stand-in, with explicit offsets for larb/AVC_VLD; when DEC02 lands I replace the table and re-run. No blocker for the implementation.

4) hw-v40 t_v40.c:1642 expects 0x16001000 to be skipped ("inside VCU but no RWVC window"); rev 3 makes it valid. I asked V40 for the minimal expectation change and will report the patched-suite result.

No phone, nothing published.
